scope: seven matrix roles in all 32 transformer blocks
limitations: Latent inputs are deterministic Gaussian samples, not states replayed from a complete denoising trajectory.
The packed values and FP16 linear inputs match the native path, but PyTorch MPS matmul is not a bit-exact emulation of the Metal kernel's product rounding.
decision: Do not quantize all 32 blocks uniformly with affine INT8/group-64.
next: Measure mixed precision by block range and matrix role, concentrating on the middle blocks where sampled activation error peaks.
